title: 三体III · 死神永生 — 小说精读 No.3

questions.question: 《死神永生》中，三体世界公开评估程心的威慑度只有 10%，人类仍选她当执剑人。为什么？
options: 评估结果在选举后才公开，人类投票时并不知道她的威慑度竟然低到这个程度
正因为看见才选她：等于宣布受够了活在随时准备毁灭一切的人手里
人类相信她在关键时刻会比评估更坚定，善良的人反而更加敢于担责
大众并不相信这个数字，认为这是敌人为了影响选举而放出的假评估
questions.explanation: 数字是公开的，人类不是没看见，而是因为看见了才选她，这个选择本身就是对威慑的厌倦。所以真正的失职发生在投票那一天，事后骂她的人其实是在骂当年想要的那个自己；「信息不知情」一项恰好把这层抹掉了。
questions.question_en: In Death's End, Trisolaris publicly rates Cheng Xin's deterrence at only 10%, yet humanity still chooses her as Swordholder. Why?
options_en: The rating was published only after the election, so voters didn't know how shockingly low her deterrence was
They chose her because they saw it: a declaration of being fed up with living in the hands of someone ready to destroy everything
They believed she would prove firmer than rated when it counted, since good people are all the more willing to take responsibility
The public didn't believe the number, taking it for a fake assessment released by the enemy to sway the election
questions.explanation_en: The number was public; humanity didn't miss it but chose her precisely because it saw it, and that choice is itself a weariness with deterrence. So the real dereliction happened on election day, and those who later curse her are really cursing the self who wanted her back then; the "uninformed voters" option erases exactly this layer.

questions.question: 《死神永生》结尾，为什么偏偏让全书最不肯为自己拿东西的程心和关一帆留下五公斤？
options: 他们是在有意反抗归零者的广播，表明人类的情感高于宇宙重生的计划
连最干净的人都会留一点，可见宇宙回不来不是道德问题，而是结构问题
揭示他们骨子里终究自私，所谓善良不过是在没有代价时才摆得出来的一种姿态
五公斤相对宇宙约等于零，说明归还已经完成，文明得以延续而没有损失
questions.explanation: 挑两个最干净的人来演这一幕，是把公地悲剧搬到宇宙尺度：灾难不需要反派，由理性又善意的个体选择加总而成。「五公斤约等于零」正是那句人人都会说的辩护，可如果每个小宇宙都留五公斤，宇宙就永远不够。
questions.question_en: At the end of Death's End, why is it specifically Cheng Xin and Guan Yifan, the people in the book least willing to take anything for themselves, who keep five kilograms?
options_en: They are deliberately defying the Returners' broadcast, showing that human feeling outranks the plan for cosmic rebirth
If even the cleanest people keep a little, the universe's failure to come back isn't a moral problem but a structural one
It reveals they are selfish at bottom, and that their so-called kindness is a pose struck only when it costs nothing
Five kilograms is about zero relative to the universe, showing the return is complete and civilization continues at no loss
questions.explanation_en: Casting the two cleanest people in this scene moves the tragedy of the commons to cosmic scale: catastrophe needs no villain, only the sum of rational, well-meaning individual choices. "Five kilograms is about zero" is exactly the defense anyone would offer, but if every mini-universe keeps five kilograms, the universe will never have enough.

questions.question: 《死神永生》里，光速飞船本是唯一真正的出路，却被人类自己禁掉。背后更深的驱动力是什么？
options: 技术判断：曲率驱动尚不成熟，当时不可能造出光速飞船
风险评估：掩体计划已被证明足以抵御已知的全部打击方式，不必再冒险
公平直觉：船票有限，如果只有一部分人能走，那就谁都别走
外部威慑：三体世界明令禁止，人类怕违约招致再次打击
questions.explanation: 明面理由是航迹会暴露坐标，真正的驱动力是「谁上船」这个人类回答不了的问题，所以禁掉它的不是三体人，而是人类自己的公平感。掩体计划也没有被证明足够：它防的是光粒，挡不住二向箔。
questions.question_en: In Death's End, lightspeed ships were the only real way out, yet humanity itself banned them. What is the deeper driving force behind this?
options_en: Technical judgment: curvature propulsion was still immature, and lightspeed ships couldn't be built at the time
Risk assessment: the Bunker Project had been proven able to withstand every known form of attack, so no further risk was needed
An instinct for fairness: tickets are limited, and if only some people can get to leave, then nobody should go
External deterrence: Trisolaris had expressly forbidden them, and humanity feared a breach would invite another strike
questions.explanation_en: The stated reason was that the ships' trails would expose humanity's coordinates; the real driver was "who gets on board," a question humanity can't answer, so what banned them wasn't the Trisolarans but humanity's own sense of fairness. Nor had the Bunker Project been proven sufficient: it guarded against photoids but couldn't stop the dual-vector foil.
